Each of these independently exceeds the 25% CPO deviation threshold or constitutes a structural policy override, and the CIC severance deviation alone triggers Board Compensation Committee approval under CAP §4.3. Where multiple approval tiers are triggered, the policy provides that the highest/committees tier governs. Accordingly, the Board Compensation Committee is the approval authority that must authorize this arrangement.
